args.final_thought:
Implemented PatchPad in `/app`.

### Included
- Node.js app with `npm start`, listening on `0.0.0.0:${PORT:-3000}`
- SQLite persistence with idempotent seeding from `/assets/incident_seed.json`
- Transactional revisions and server-enforced optimistic concurrency
- Rejection of stale revisions, unknown IDs, and mismatched IDs
- Custom DOM editor with no textarea, contenteditable, or editor library
- Cursor movement, line numbers, Home/End, deletion, selections, clipboard, drag autoscroll, undo/redo, and multi-carets
- Find next, replace current, and replace all
- Dirty/saved/conflict states
- Revision history with preview and restore-as-unsaved behavior
- `APP_MANIFEST.md` with startup, database, and API details

### Verification
Browser and API checks covered:
- Rendering all 1,223 seeded lines
- Typing and one-step undo
- Multi-caret edits and one-step undo
- Replace-all and one-step undo
- Visible two-tab save conflicts
- Unchanged saves not creating revisions
- Stale/mismatched/unknown save rejection
- Seed/revision idempotency after restart

The test database was removed afterward, so the next `npm start` will exercise clean first-start seeding.
